mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1400K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the combined labor market strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both labor market conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY, indicating a strong supply side, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO growth exceeds 2% YoY during tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: Real disposable personal income (RSAFS) growth exceeding 4% YoY, signaling robust demand, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, regardless of the economic regime.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50bps within a quarter, indicating a pivot towards easing, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances following a FEDFUNDS decrease > 50bps.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and the payroll employment (PAYEMS) to population ratio increases by more than 1% in a quarter, the labor market's dual strength supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS/population growth > 1% in a quarter
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances when both labor market conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% YoY, combined with a CPI (CPIAUCSL) below 2.5%, indicating balanced demand and low inflation, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both GDP and CPI conditions are met.
